import cadquery as cq
result = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .transformed(offset=cq.Vector(0.0, 0.0, -27.55), rotate=cq.Vector(0, 0, 0))
    .circle(49.8)
    .extrude(55.1)
    .union(
        cq.Workplane("XY")
            .transformed(offset=cq.Vector(0.0, 0.0, 27.55), rotate=cq.Vector(0, 0, 0))
            .circle(49.8)
            .extrude(10.0)
    )
    .union(
        cq.Workplane("XY")
            .transformed(offset=cq.Vector(0.0, 0.0, -27.55), rotate=cq.Vector(0, 0, 0))
            .sphere(49.8)
    )
    .union(
        cq.Workplane("XY")
            .cylinder(6.4, 58.8)
    )
    .union(
        cq.Workplane("XY")
            .transformed(offset=cq.Vector(0.0, 0.0, 86.47), rotate=cq.Vector(0, 0, 0))
            .cylinder(24.6, 5.3)
    )
    .union(
        cq.Workplane("XY")
            .transformed(offset=cq.Vector(0.0, 0.0, -86.47), rotate=cq.Vector(0, 0, 0))
            .cylinder(24.6, 5.3)
    )
)
show_object(result)
